summary: Access request: Grafana Provision-to-Ready dashboards + Fleet Readiness tooling permissions (least-privilege)
description:
Requester: Harish Reddy (Infra/Fleet ops rollout coordinator)

Request:
Need access for Fleet Ops to the new Provision-to-Ready Grafana dashboards and readiness tooling ahead of staged rollout (us-east / A100). Specifically:
1) Grafana folder: “Provision-to-Ready” (dashboards + alert views; read-only is fine)
2) Fleet Readiness Service internal UI endpoint (read-only; ability to view per-node state + validation failure reason + artifact pointers)

Business justification:
- On-call readiness during staged rollout; need to quickly diagnose nodes stuck in Provisioning/Validating and see step breakdown/failure heatmaps.
- Coordinate with SRE on alert tuning without needing ad-hoc screen shares.

Access constraints / least-privilege request:
- Read-only access only. No permission to mutate readiness state, quarantine nodes, or change image channel.
- Group-based access preferred (no individual exceptions), with audit trail.

Users requested (initial):
- Harish Reddy
- Jamal Pierce

Notes:
- We want to avoid broad “Grafana Admin” / “Platform Admin” permissions. Viewer access should be sufficient for this stage.
- If later we need operator actions (quarantine override / retry validations), we will file a separate ticket with explicit scope and approver list.

Requested by: Harish Reddy
Team: Eng-Infra / GPU Fleet & Capacity
Timing: Needed before go/no-go checklist review for first staged rollout.
comments: 2025-10-10 09:18 (Fiona McCarthy): Confirming scope. For least-privilege: we can grant Grafana folder Viewer + Fleet Readiness Service read-only role. Mutating endpoints require separate approval and are restricted to Platform on-call + SRE per current policy. Please confirm the two names and whether access should extend to the broader #eng-infra on-call rotation.
2025-10-10 09:27 (Harish Reddy): Confirmed names are Harish Reddy + Jamal Pierce for now. Not requesting full rotation yet; we’ll expand once we stabilize dashboards/alerts and finalize runbook.

2025-10-10 10:05 (Fiona McCarthy): Approvals required:
- Infra/Fleet manager approval (Vanessa Ortiz)
- SRE approval for dashboard/alert visibility (Sean Gallagher or Rafael Mendes)
Please reply in-thread with explicit “approved” so we can attach to the ticket.
2025-10-10 10:32 (Vanessa Ortiz): Approved for Harish Reddy + Jamal Pierce. Viewer-only access is appropriate for rollout ops. Please ensure access is via group and logged.
2025-10-10 11:10 (Sean Gallagher): Approved. Viewer access only. Any alert rule edits or paging policy changes must continue to go through SRE (Rafael/Miles/Aisha) during rollout week.

2025-10-10 13:44 (Fiona McCarthy): Implementing via Okta/SSO group-based RBAC:
- Group: grafana-provision-to-ready-viewers (Grafana folder viewer)
- Group: fleet-readiness-ro (Read-only access to readiness state + validation artifacts; no POST/PUT)
We are explicitly NOT adding to:
- fleet-readiness-ops (quarantine/retry privileges)
- grafana-admin
Audit note: group membership changes will be logged and reviewable.
ETA: ~30 minutes for propagation.

2025-10-10 14:31 (Harish Reddy): Confirmed I can see the “Provision-to-Ready” dashboards and drill into step timings/failure heatmap. Fleet Readiness UI also loads and shows failure reason + artifact link pointers. Looks good.

2025-10-11 09:02 (Fiona McCarthy): Closing as resolved. If you later need operator actions (retry validation, quarantine override, or image channel changes), file a separate INT ticket with:
- exact endpoints/actions needed
- list of users/on-call rotation
- time-bounded access if applicable
- additional approval from Platform sponsor (Priya Natarajan) because it’s state-mutating.
resolution: Granted group-based read-only access to (1) Grafana Provision-to-Ready dashboards and (2) Fleet Readiness Service read-only UI/API for Harish Reddy and Jamal Pierce. Access explicitly constrained to viewer/RO roles; no state mutation permissions. Approvals recorded from Vanessa Ortiz and Sean Gallagher.
security_notes: Least-privilege enforced via separate RO vs OPS roles; no admin grants. Access changes performed via SSO group membership with audit trail. Mutating permissions require separate ticket + Platform sponsor approval.
attachments: Approval captured in ticket comments from Vanessa Ortiz and Sean Gallagher
